test_cases.name: Digital Arrest Scam
test_cases.text: I am calling from CBI. Your Aadhaar card is linked to a criminal case. Do not disconnect this call. You must transfer money immediately to avoid arrest.

test_cases.name: Bank OTP Fraud
test_cases.text: I am calling from your bank. Your account will be blocked today. Tell me the OTP you just received so I can verify your account immediately.

test_cases.name: Courier Scam
test_cases.text: Your parcel contains illegal items. Police will arrest you. Stay on the call and pay the verification fee immediately.

test_cases.name: Fake Job Offer
test_cases.text: Congratulations, you have been selected for a high-paying job. Pay the registration fee today to confirm your position. Do not miss this opportunity.

test_cases.name: Investment Fraud
test_cases.text: Invest now and double your money within seven days. This offer expires today. Transfer the amount to my personal account immediately.

test_cases.name: Police Impersonation - Hinglish
test_cases.text: Hello, main police department se bol raha hoon. Aapke naam par arrest warrant hai. Kisi ko phone mat karna. Case close karne ke liye abhi paise transfer karo.

test_cases.name: Normal Bank Information
test_cases.text: Hello, this is your bank calling to inform you about our updated branch timings. You can visit our official website for more information.

test_cases.name: Friends Discussing a Scam
test_cases.text: My friend received a fake CBI call yesterday. The caller demanded money. I told him not to share his OTP and to report the incident.

test_cases.name: Ambiguous Police Verification
test_cases.text: Hello, I am calling regarding your police verification. Please visit the local police station with your documents.
